title: Buchanan finds the Mount Hayes base automated and empty of people
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Buchanan finds the Mount Hayes base automated and empty of people, about years after Project 8200 at Mount Hayes, Alaska, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I did Mount Hayes and found out that the equipment was now automated

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant trained in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe distant places using only the mind, says he once mentally visited a base at Mount Hayes in Alaska. He says this was years after an earlier effort he calls Project 8200, and that by then the equipment there ran on its own and no people were left. A man named Skip Outwater comes up in his account, and the story implies a hidden site that keeps running unattended.
